'''Bonekrusher Arsonist''' is an [[Advanced enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker armed with a flamethrower. Although these weapons look shoddily made, they serve their intended purpose well enough. Arsonists can easily clear out strong points and send the defenders, however stubborn, running for their lives.}}

==Overview==
As Bonekrushers with a flamethrower, Bonekrusher Arsonists are known for their abilities to cause mayhem with their flamethrowers:

*Jets fire at front, dealing continuous Heat damage and {{G|Heat Infliction}}.
*Jets fire at front continuously, dealing continuous Heat damage and {{G|Heat Infliction}}.
*Kicks at front, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*Jets fire in an arc, dealing Heat damage and {{G|Heat Infliction}}, and leaving the ground burning, which deals continuous Heat damage and {{G|Heat Infliction}} to Operators on it.
